predict.question: Your group chat starts with you; each round, every newest member invites two others, but the chat holds at most 7 members. After four rounds of invites, how many members?

exploreHint: Compare both named cases and inspect what changes.
bookIdea: Network size and structure constrain the reach of expanding paths.
modelBoundary: Three rounds reach {A}; four still reach {B}. After the supplied finite cap is reached, another round cannot create additional allowed nodes.
doesItHoldUp: Does it hold up? This bounds a capped tree, not general-network distances, hubs or bridges. Collisions are absent before the cap.
